description: DAFFS predicts solar flares using magnetic-field measurements, prior flare activity and discriminant analysis. Its forecasts can use alternative observations or climatology when preferred inputs are unavailable. The resource is documented by NWRA. The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (Flare Scoreboard). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Forecasts depend on the available input stream and the selected event threshold and validity window. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
